common.device: local RTX PRO 6000; frozen CUDA features for statistical experiments; fresh frame inference for streaming benchmark
common.data_scope: Existing historical test and edited normal sources are development evidence, including repeated OOF analyses. New seeds/edits do not restore independence.
common.fit: normal FIT only; neural hyperparameter selection by normal validation loss
common.calibration: reference score distributions; separate threshold split for final operating threshold; never tune thresholds to evaluated anomaly recall
common.far_warning: Calibration target is not achieved test FAR. Do not choose test thresholds to force matched test FAR.

bootstrap.unit: paired source file within scene; new data use recording session

common.timebase: existing recording-length T, D=round-half-up(.2T), W=round-half-up(.4T); hold evaluation windows fixed during tracker-period comparisons

E11B.reuse: exact full historical/normal scores and branch window maxima; recalibrate new arm thresholds from normal threshold scores
E11B.replay_required: new-threshold synthetic delay and alarm duration cannot be recovered from old scalar delay summaries
E11B.sensitivity: Report all four leave-one-scene-out macros, explicitly R02 excluded; not unseen-scene generalization.

E15A.scope: frozen component distributions, branch winners, phase/startup and pre/post-anomaly normal strata; score shifts are not automatically attributed to lighting

calibration_arms.G0: existing reference tails and video-equal window-q99
calibration_arms.G1: video-equal reference component CDFs; same threshold-window weighting
calibration_arms.G2: G1 plus 4-bin conditional CDF with fixed 0.5 global shrinkage

fusion_arms.F1: branch empirical D-window tail budget alpha/m with OR alarms; continuous ranking from reference-window minimum tail probability

screening_only.warning: Engineering screening on existing development data; adopting based on synthetic outcomes must be disclosed and independently confirmed.

preflight: visible repeated cycles and normal waits
arms: T1 observation likelihood using same causal descriptor
forbidden_ground_truth: frame index divided by full test length
linear interpolation presented as continuous GT

E13B.appearance_scope: No A in process-only comparison; add same C after temporal comparison. Old P7 includes A and cannot be relabeled Q1.
period_controls: FIT-annotation T diagnostic with disclosed extra normal supervision

controls: continuous-onset reverse versus same-initial-frame forward continuation
lag-2/8/32 change-magnitude matched order-preserving stress windows
E14B.matching_scope: normal feature distances; no anomaly score matching; publish eligible/matched coverage; stress controls are not automatically genuine normal process states
E14B.state_recovery: separate comparison to original trajectory using source map only for evaluation
E14B.oracle_reset: diagnostic only, not deployable online score

E12B.seed43_44_scope: predeclared total-rank64 and per-phase-rank64 contrasts only
E12B.unsupported_rank: unavailable; report common-supported subset and full coverage, do not silently relabel a lower rank

methods: INFP subject to reproducible implementation availability
external_baselines.offline_methods: separate reference table or explicitly labeled causal adaptation

streaming.causality_check: same prefix output after different suffixes
streaming.unknown_fps: report ms/frame and configured-rate replay only

independent_confirmation.existing_S01_S12: audit prior use and asset/session overlap before freezing all unused scenes; synthetic same-dataset extension, not independent real validation
independent_confirmation.normal_fit_calibration_sessions: separate from test sessions; normal fitting allowed with frozen algorithm, not zero-shot
independent_confirmation.groups: recording session; derivatives and episodes remain clustered

publication: New experiment stages remain pending until execution, artifact validation and stage report. Publish completed stage metrics/logs and README tables/figures without overwriting old E11/E12/E14A.
